ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a contrast ratio estimated at 1:15 relative to sparse high-intensity (white) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation covering >95% of visible area, punctuated by ~30 discrete, high-intensity white circular clusters (diameter 3-10 pixels) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is high.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire margin; left distal tip shows extreme non-linear jaggedness and significant pixel-depth variations compared to the right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters arranged in random configurations across the central and lateral dark regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sets of parallel, high-intensity diagonal linear pixel disruptions located on the upper right lobe and upper left lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular contour disruption and apparent tissue loss at the left distal tip; multiple sets of parallel linear striations (scars) visible on the upper lobe surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity, textured clusters indicating biological colonization concentrated on the extreme distal tips and segments of the trailing edges.
